This unidentified '''crested Jedi''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were remembered in the form of multiple [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] busts spread throughout in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="Episode II" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Crested-Jedi-Maquette-GL.png|thumb|left|200px|This design was one of many presented as maquettes to George Lucas to choose from for what would ultimately become the character, Dexter Jettster, and his species, the Besalisks.]]
This design was originally created as a maquette bust by [[John Knoll]] and team to serve as a potential design for the character [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], presented alongside twenty-three others for [[George Lucas]] to choose from. Though Lucas would eventually request to combine two of the other head sculpts to become the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] species, a handful of the unselected maquettes would be recycled into additional aliens, primarily Jedi, to be used in {{Film|II}},<ref name="FPtP">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=From Puppets to Pixels: Digital Characters in Episode II}}</ref> including the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] species, as well as the [[Vurk/Legends|Vurk]] [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]], the [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] [[Pablo-Jill/Legends|Pablo-Jill]], and the various busts of famous and infamous Jedi displayed throughout the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], such as [[Chon Actrion/Legends|Chon Actrion]] and this one.<ref name="Episode II" />
